digest.component_or_area: container plan-review attestation and file-impact scope inheritance
propositions: A live child declared `none` is neutral in drift-scope inheritance: it contributes no paths and does not poison sibling path declarations or force whole-HEAD invalidation.
Any live undeclared child poisons child inheritance, preventing promotion to all-none and yielding unscoped fallback when no parent or citation paths exist.
Explicit parent paths take precedence over all-none children: the manifest signs parent path dependencies and does not synthesize a file-scope:none marker.
Cheap resign preserves the same child-derived signed scope using immutable relation snapshots without network reads.
P9 validation passes leaves and containers whose live children are all declared, advising only live undeclared children and naming both path and `--none` remedies.

The scope precedence rule applies exactly: any own/cited/inherited path yields `paths`; else explicit parent `none` yields `none`; else all-live-children-none promotes undeclared parent to `none`; else `unscoped`.`
